inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person (every tier)
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to all six sites); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Entry to all six sites (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)

inclusions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to all six sites); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the Base fare
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.

exclusions.text: Tomb of Nefertari (QV66) and Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62): separately ticketed and bought on site
exclusions.source: The Tomb of Nefertari (QV66) and the Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62) are capped-access, separately ticketed and bought on site — tell us in advance if either is essential and the Egyptologist can position you in the right Valley early.
